item.tib: dri med lhan skyes snyan rgyud dkar po sum sbyor gyis dbang gis yig chung gsal byed me long
item.coloph: snyan rgyud dbang gis (gi) yig chung gsal byed me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mtshungs med u 'bar bro gar drang srong shes rab rgyal mtshan dang*/ bslab gsum dbang phyug gya ge drang srong g.yung drung shes rab rnam gnyis gyi (kyis/)thugs kyi dgongs pa nan cher bskul ba'i don/ dbang gis (gi) yig chung rjes gnang gsal byed las sogs gzhung gis (gi) dgongs pa dang / ldong zhig nam mkha' dang*/ zhu g.yas ye shes blo gros kyis phyag len ci lta bar/ gab sbas rnams bla ma'i gsungs sgros ltar/ rang gis go don phyogs gcig tu (sdeb (bsdebs) nas/ phyogs kyi sgom chen pa/ dpal 'byor lhun grub ces bya ba'i(bas/)gnas chen bon ri'i yang dben/ bkra shis lha rtse ces bya ba sbyar ba la/ 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bla ma yi dam dang*/ mkha' 'gro dbal mo'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus kun/ smin grol zab mo'i lam bkod nas kyang / zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i sku thob shog/
